content.short: Resolv is a decentralized stablecoin protocol that issues USR, a delta-neutral asset backed by both ETH and BTC.
content.description: Resolv is an innovative decentralized finance protocol designed to provide users with a secure and stable digital asset through USR, its flagship delta-neutral stablecoin. Unlike traditional assets backed by fiat or single-sided collateral, USR is backed by a diversified portfolio of ETH and BTC, utilizing advanced hedging strategies to maintain its value peg regardless of market volatility. The protocol's three-token model includes USR for stability, RLP for insurance and yield generation, and RESOLV for ecosystem governance. Operating on Ethereum, Resolv provides a secure environment.
content.meta: Resolv provides the USR delta-neutral stablecoin and decentralized asset management. Discover Resolv and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer now.
